newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunis bourse index closes almost unchanged.
newsitem.headline: Tunis bourse index closes almost unchanged.

text.p: The Tunis Stock Exchange on Thursday closed almost unchanged in higher trading, bourse sources said.
The market's 30-share index closed at 617.35 from 617.56 on Wednesday.
Trade volume was 1.7 million dinars ($1.7 million) against 556,140 dinars.
Arab Tunisian Bank was up 3.66 dinars to 56.04 dinars. Banque du Sud up 0.89 dinar to 30.86 dinars. ($=0.96 dinar)
